_comment: Was a STATIC. A plain STATIC is dispatched by nothing and MODIFY_ATTACK buffs the CURRENT attack, of which there is none when a non-attack action resolves — so this did not merely apply too broadly, it did not run. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK is the one-shot: consumed by the first matching attack, expiring with the turn if unused. 'Play only if you've discarded a card with 6 or more {p} this turn' is a play RESTRICTION, not an additional cost: it must block play, not charge for it.
